title.zh: 将高山省 Bauko 市镇 Monamon Norte描笼涯Tipunan村落的Mount Data国立中学的Tipunan附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Mount Data National High School - Tipunan Annex in Sitio Tipunan, Barangay Monamon Norte, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province from the Mount Data National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tipunan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Mount Data National High School - Tipunan Annex in Sitio Tipunan, Barangay Monamon Norte, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province from the Mount Data National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tipunan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tipunan của Trường Trung học Mount Data Quốc gia tại Barangay Monamon Norte, Đô thị Bauko, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Mount Data Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tipunan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tipunan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mount Data แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Monamon Norte เทศบาล Bauko จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mount Data แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tipunan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tipunan, Sekolah Menengah Mount Data Nasional di Barangay Monamon Norte, Kotamadya Bauko, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Mount Data Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tipunan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tipunan, Sekolah Menengah Mount Data Kebangsaan di Barangay Monamon Norte, Perbandaran Bauko, Wilayah Mountain Province daripada Sekolah Menengah Mount Data Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tipunan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Mount Data National High School - Tipunan Annex in Sitio Tipunan, Barangay Monamon Norte, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province is hereby separated from the Mount Data National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tipunan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Mount Data National High School - Tipunan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tipunan National High School.

Appropriations. The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Tipunan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mount Data National High School - Tipunan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
